verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing describes general reporting: building reports and dashboards on labor cost trends, joining and pivoting data with calculated fields, and monitoring compensation trends. It also offers pay-run comparison and accounting-system integrations, which partly cover payroll analysis. Nothing in the pack explicitly mentions payroll registers, gross-to-net reports or exporting reports. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register report, gross-to-net report, documented export formats (CSV/Excel), independent or hands-on corroboration.
